title: 第三章 媚杀 · 下
content_zh:
小三正在拿那把剑劈柴时晚媚回来了，站在他旁边盯他。
看来你是什么都知道。盯了一会她发话：那个黑屋子里面是谁，他喜欢什么，我们进去要做什么，这些你都知道，既然知道就说来听听吧。
小三回身，脸色有些肃穆：我不知道，什么都不知道，你
晚媚愕然，突然间有种感觉，自己以前一直把这个影子看轻了。
小三的脸色这时稍缓，又垂下手：这么说主子是被选中了吗？
晚媚点头，下面的话还没来得及说，就听到院子里有了嘈杂声。
她迎出门去，看见院里突然多了四五个人，全都抱了包袱低头走路，一会功夫就都钻进了原先空置的下人房。
同来的晚香一把挽住她手，拖她来到院门，将手一指高处道：恭喜妹子正式成为地杀，你看，这院子如今就有名字了。
晚媚抬头，看见院门上已经被人凿了两个漂亮的楷体字，写着媚杀。
妹子往后就是媚杀了。晚香亲密的拍打她手背：咱们往后就是平起平坐，可要互相照应。
晚媚有些明白了，原来下午那间黑屋子里面是在选秀，她被选中后变成了地杀，那么另外那三个女子应该也都是候补了。
于是她露出贝齿笑了，也笑得没心没肺：说什么呢姐姐，妹子来的晚什么都不懂，以后还要靠姐姐调教。
成为地杀之后，院里的日子没有多大变化，最大的变化就是多了五个仆人，小三于是清闲了很多。
调教还是要继续，这天小三拿来宣纸笔墨，说是要晚媚学着写字。
外头绿意萌动，晚媚有些春困，不耐的伸着懒腰：字是不用学了，我爹是个落第秀才，从小就逼我写大字念诗经的。
晚香这时候恰巧来串门，听了这话莞尔：这个你就不懂了妹子，咱这里学写字可和别处不同，大大的不同。
说完她就拍手，她的影子初八应声而出，在她身后缩肩膀垂头。
晚香吩咐他钻下桌子，边吩咐边笑：我们家初八可是口技惊人，舌头上能开莲花呢。
一旁小三跟上开口：那么就请主子写首五言诗，用楷体，我顺便说说红魔伞。
晚媚有些莫名其妙的落座，拿起毛笔沾墨，很是规矩的写了个床字。

桌子下面初八看了眼主人，慢慢前挪，挪到了晚媚裙摆下面。
鬼门的规矩是不穿小裤，所以初八很快找到了目标。
晚媚这时正在写个前字，忽然间感觉有个灵巧湿润的舌头滑过她大腿，身子一个颤动就把字写偏了。
晚香吃吃发笑，代她换过一张宣纸，示意她从头开始。
小三这时。这是朵尸花，原来专门长在死人身上。
话里透着诡异，晚媚脊背有些发寒，下身却益发滚烫起来。
初八这时已经掰开了她双腿，拿舌头舔她毛发，一寸寸舔的仔细。
晚媚手脚发颤，好不容易才又勉强写了个床字。
初八的舌头这时已经移到了花穴，几下舔弄后开始吸吮，一吸一放刺激她阴蒂。
麻酥的快感裹袭全身，下身湿润，初八含了口那液体，咕咚咽下。
晚媚的心也咯噔一响，赶紧屏息飞快的写完了第一句。
小三仍在继续：这朵花如今是寄生在了伞上，根被花芯里面的蛊虫缠住，爬满了伞面。因为是尸花，所以平时它没有动静，只有闻见死人气味才会舒展开来，去吸死人的血。
花芯里面的虫，听到这形容晚媚发笑，心想还真是应景。
初八的舌头这时已经伸直，穿进她私处，在里面颤动卷裹，可不就像钻进花芯的虫。
一段时间刺激后晚媚有了感觉，乳头发硬呼吸急促，左手连忙捉住桌边，趁高潮没到又写了两句。
小三继续：你见过金莲吸血了吧，那些红丝其实不是花蕊，是里面血蛊虫的触角，伸出来吸人精血的
晚媚立时想起了那晚的情景，想起红丝是怎么探进庞德胸膛，进入他身体，把个八尺汉子吸成了一副空囊。
恐惧增加了快感，私处爱液滚滚而下，初八的舌头在一片湿地里翻滚，最后又退出来不断啃咬她阴唇，晚媚终于吃消不住，预感到高潮就要来到。
这时她仍有三分清明，赶在意识涣散前连忙写那最后五个字。
最后一个乡字写完时，高潮如期来到，初八的舌头依旧颤动不停，于是这个高潮就在颤动里迭迭高起，最后冲云破日不可遏止。

宣纸上面字迹勉强还算工整，晚媚喘着气将头搁上台面，问向小三：这下可算写完了。
小三抬眼看她：那么请问主子，我刚才说吸了几个人鲜血之后，血蛊虫会成熟，能被主子所用？
晚媚眨眨眼，只能听他重复：我刚才说蛊虫吸了十个人鲜血之后就成熟了，主子可以采它下来派大用场。您刚才没听见，说明主子在关键时还不够清醒，还得重来。这次我来念词，主子您记。
晚媚哀嚎一声，身下初八又开始动作。
这次换了花样，初八探进手指，在她里面找到了极乐点不断刺激，而舌头还在外头不断舔弄吸吮。
快感更是无以复加，加上小三念的词又是繁复，晚媚吃力，在连着三个高潮过后这才勉强成功。
过后她下身湿漉难当，趴在桌间喘气，晚香则是拿了她的词在一旁细看。
凤箫吟。念了词牌名她吃吃笑了起来：这词倒是贴切，妹子定力还是不错，想当初我可是练来练去练不成，也难怪门主赏识你，见你两次就赏你扇子。
小三沉默了，满屋子于是只剩下晚媚的咻咻喘气声。
可是小三你不该这么大意。过一会晚香转了身，深深看住小三：领了扇子还闲逛到绝杀门口，让她撞见问你，问后吃了大醋，派妹子去执行那么凶险的任务。
这话里分明是还有话，晚媚第一时间发觉，抬头来看向小三，眼内寒光灼灼。
小三还是沉默，不解释，只是低下了头。
※※※※
之后将近两个月小三都没有解释，在晚媚看来，这等抵死沉默就等于默认，默认是他故意坑害她，让上头给她派了个最凶险的任务。
这念头让她心生怨毒，怨毒不断生长，在小三寒蛊发作时达到了顶点。
还是老规矩，门主亲自召见晚媚给了解药，这次没有节外生枝。
回来后晚媚在房间角落里找到小三，看见他正和上次一样挤做一团。
我再给你一次机会解释。她弯腰，拿解药在他眼前摇晃：你最好别说谎话。
小三吃力地睁开双眼，看过她又看过解药，最终还是沉默，低头团身，将脸埋进膝盖。
晚媚敛眉，也不再多话，

做这些时她心安理得，也不觉得自己会后悔，甚至晚上还到小三窗前，想看他痛苦样子解恨。
半天不见小三还蜷在原处，背抵住墙角，头埋进膝盖。
晚媚发觉他衣袖下有血，于是走进门去，看见他果然是咬着自家膀子，嘴里活生生含着一块肉。
晚媚伸手去拔，拔了许久才把他膀子拔出来。
那块肉也断了根，被他咬在牙关里丝丝渗血。
晚媚回身，去床上撕下块床单塞进他嘴巴，看着他身子僵硬轻轻抽搐，突然间没法忍受，一跺脚奔出了房门。
夜里倒也不是无眠，只是时时惊醒，觉得窗外的风声也象呜咽。
第二天第三天寒毒还不褪去，晚媚突然想起串门，到晚香那里一待就是一天。
晚上回转时肚子有点饿，晚媚拐进厨房，却看见新来的厨娘正抱着小三，四处张望不知如何是好。
见她进门厨娘连忙将人放下：主子你瞧瞧，我刚才进来看夜宵，看见他把手塞进炉膛子里，要再晚一步那手可就烧没了。
晚媚低腰，看见小三衣袖果然是烧没了半截，手臂手掌是惨不忍睹，早一片焦黑皮开肉绽。
她一时定神，看着小三挣扎，还想往炉膛去取暖，突然间落了泪，一把张开怀抱将他抱住。
这是她来鬼门后第一次落泪，泪水微凉却滚烫，小三在她怀抱，渐渐平复不再挣扎。
终于要过去了，三天三夜的寒蛊发作，三天三夜的两相折磨。
这之后小三休整了两天，伤口草草包扎，照他自己的话说，有鬼门的上好伤药，这些伤根本算不得什么。
晚媚是有些懊悔的，可是不肯说，只是对牢窗外春梅发怔。
见小三站到身后，她开始叹气：今天是我生日，我才十七岁，可为什么感觉象活了几辈子。
她这人性子刚强，很少伤春悲秋，小三听着不忍，一转身去了厨房。
回来的时候手里端着碗面，汤头清凉的阳春面，上面漂着细碎葱花。
晚媚挑了一根入口，尝出是小三而不是厨娘的手艺。

看了小三裹满纱布的双手，她心中柔软处牵动，道：谢谢你这碗长寿面，不管你对我是真心还是假意，我都谢谢你这碗面。
小三还是垂手：那么主子吃完之后，咱们好好筹划这次的任务。
晚媚双眼顿时黯淡：是啊，要筹划，那个人叫韩修是吧，据说不仅是个一等高手，而且为人正统不好女色，是个爱妻如命的妻管严。

While Xiao San was chopping firewood with the sword, Wan Mei came back and stood next to him, staring at him.
It seems you know everything. After staring for a while, she spoke: You know who is in that dark room, what he likes, and what we are going to do when we go in. Now that you know it, let’s talk about it.
The mistress turned around with a solemn expression: I don’t know, I don’t know anything, you
Wan Mei was stunned, and suddenly felt that she had underestimated this shadow before.
The mistress' expression softened slightly at this moment, and she lowered her hand: So the master has been chosen?
Wan Mei nodded. Before she could say the next words, she heard noise in the yard.
She went out and saw four or five people suddenly in the courtyard. They all carried their bundles and walked with their heads down. After a while, they all got into the previously vacant servant's room.
Wanxiang, who came with her, took her hand and dragged her to the courtyard gate. She pointed her hand to a high place and said, "Congratulations, sister, for officially becoming a local killer. You see, this courtyard now has a name."
Wan Mei looked up and saw that two beautiful characters in regular script had been chiseled into the courtyard door, which read "Mei Sha".
The girl will be charming from now on. Wanxiang patted the back of her hand intimately: We will be equals from now on, but we must take care of each other.
Wan Mei understood a little. It turned out that there was a talent show in the dark room in the afternoon. After she was selected, she became a ground killer, so the other three women should also be candidates.
So she smiled with her teeth exposed, and she smiled heartlessly: What are you talking about, sister? She came late and doesn’t understand anything. She will have to rely on her sister for training in the future.
After becoming an underground killer, the life in the courtyard has not changed much. The biggest change is that there are five more servants, so the mistress has a lot of leisure.
The training had to continue. Today, the mistress brought rice paper, pen and ink and said she wanted Wan Mei to learn to write.
The greenery was blooming outside, and Wan Mei felt a little sleepy, stretching impatiently: "There is no need to learn Chinese characters. My father is a failed scholar, and has forced me to write in big characters and recite the Book of Songs since I was a child."
Wanxiang happened to come to visit at this time, and smiled after hearing this: You don't understand this, girl, learning to write here is different from other places, very different.
After saying this, she clapped her hands, and her shadow Chu Ba appeared in response, shrinking her shoulders and lowering her head behind her.
Wanxiang ordered him to get off the table, and smiled as she ordered: Our eighth grader has amazing oral skills, and he can bloom lotus flowers on his tongue.
The mistress on the side followed suit and said: "Then please master, please write a five-character poem in regular script. By the way, I will talk about the Red Devil Umbrella."
Wan Mei sat down inexplicably, picked up a brush and dipped it in ink, and wrote the word "bed" in a very formal manner.
Under the table, Chu Ba glanced at the owner and slowly moved forward, moving under the hem of Wan Mei's skirt.
The rule of the ghost gate is not to wear underwear, so Chu Ba quickly found his target.
Wan Mei was writing the word "before" when she suddenly felt a dexterous and moist tongue sliding across her thigh, and with a tremor of her body, she wrote the word off.
Wanxiang chuckled and changed a piece of rice paper for her, indicating that she would start from the beginning.
The mistress is at this time. This is a corpse flower. It turns out that it grows exclusively on dead people.
There was something strange in the words, and Wan Mei's back felt a little chilly, but her lower body became increasingly hot.
Chu Ba had already spread her legs and licked her hair carefully, inch by inch.
Wan Mei's hands and feet were trembling, and she finally managed to write the word "bed" again.
Chu Ba's tongue had already moved to the flower hole. After a few licks, he began to suck, sucking and releasing to stimulate her clitoris.
A numbing sensation enveloped the whole body, and the lower body was moist. Chu Ba took the liquid in his mouth and swallowed it.
Wan Mei's heart skipped a beat, and she quickly finished the first sentence while holding her breath.
Mistress is still continuing: This flower is now parasitic on the umbrella, its roots are entangled by the poisonous insects in the core of the flower, and it is crawling all over the umbrella surface. Because it is a corpse flower, it usually does not move. Only when it smells the smell of the dead will it stretch out and suck the blood of the dead.
The insect inside the flower core laughed when he heard this description of Wanmei, thinking that it really suited the occasion.
earlyBa's tongue had already straightened out, penetrating into her private parts, vibrating and curling inside, not like a worm burrowing into the core of a flower.
After a period of stimulation, Wan Mei started to feel something. Her nipples became hard and her breathing became rapid. She quickly grabbed the edge of the table with her left hand and wrote a few more sentences before the climax came.
The mistress continued: Have you ever seen a golden lotus sucking blood? Those red threads are actually not stamens, but the tentacles of the blood poisonous insects inside, which stretch out to suck human blood.
Wan Mei immediately remembered the scene that night, remembering how the red thread penetrated Pang De's chest, entered his body, and sucked the eight-foot man into an empty bag.
Fear increased the pleasure, and the love liquid rolled down from her private parts. Chuba's tongue rolled in the wetland, and finally withdrew and kept biting her labia. Wan Mei finally couldn't bear it anymore, and she had a premonition that the climax was coming.
At this time, she was still three points clear, and she quickly wrote the last five words before her consciousness faded.
When the last word "xiang" was written, the climax came as expected. Chu Ba's tongue was still trembling, so the climax kept rising one after another in the trembling, and finally it shot through the clouds and the sun unstoppably.
The handwriting on the rice paper was still neat. Wan Mei panted and put her head on the table, asking Xiang Xiaosan: "Now I have finished writing."
The mistress raised her eyes and looked at her: "Excuse me, master, I just said that after sucking the blood of a few people, the blood voodoo will mature and be used by the master?"
Wan Mei blinked and could only listen to him repeat: I just said that the voodoo will mature after sucking the blood of ten people. The master can harvest it and put it to great use. You didn't hear it just now, which means that the master was not awake enough at the critical moment, and he had to start over. This time I will recite the words, Master, please remember.
Wan Mei wailed, and Chu Ba started to move again.
This time, the pattern was changed. Chu Ba inserted his fingers and found the bliss point inside her to keep stimulating, while his tongue continued to lick and suck on the outside.
The pleasure was even more intense, and the words Xiao San recited were complicated. Wan Mei struggled, and she barely succeeded after three climaxes in a row.

The phoenix flute chants. She chuckled after reciting the name of the Ci brand: This word is quite appropriate. The girl's concentration is still good. I think I couldn't practice it at the beginning. It's no wonder that the master of the sect appreciates you and gives you a fan after seeing you twice.
The mistress fell silent, and the only sound left in the room was Wan Mei's gasping.
But mistress, you shouldn't be so careless. After a while, Wanxiang turned around and took a deep look at the mistress: After getting the fan, she wandered to the door of Juesha, letting her bump into you and ask you. After asking, she became jealous and sent the girl to carry out such a dangerous mission.
There was clearly something more in these words. Wan Mei noticed it immediately and raised her head to look at Xiao San, with a cold light in her eyes.
The mistress remained silent and did not explain, but just lowered her head.
※※※※
There was no explanation from the mistress for nearly two months. In Wan Mei's view, this silence until death was tantamount to acquiescence. The acknowledgment was that he deliberately harmed her and asked the superiors to assign her the most dangerous mission.
This thought made her feel resentful, and the resentment continued to grow, reaching its peak when Xiao San's cold poison attacked.
It was still the old rule. The sect leader personally summoned Wan Mei to give her the antidote. This time there were no complications.
After coming back, Wan Mei found the mistress in the corner of the room and saw him huddled together like last time.
I'll give you another chance to explain. She bent down and shook the antidote in front of his eyes: You'd better not lie.
The mistress opened her eyes with difficulty, looked at her and then looked at the antidote, but finally remained silent, bowed her head and buried her face in her knees.
Wan Mei frowned and stopped talking.
When she did this, she felt at ease and didn't think she would regret it. She even went to the mistress's window at night, wanting to see him in pain and relieve her hatred.
After a long time, I saw that the mistress was still curled up in the same place, with her back against the corner and her head buried in her knees.
Wan Mei noticed blood under his sleeves, so she walked in the door and saw that he was biting her arm with a piece of meat still alive in his mouth.
Wan Mei reaches out her handPull it out. It took a long time to pull out his arm.
The piece of flesh was also broken, and it oozed blood when he bit it between his teeth.
Wan Mei turned around, went to the bed, tore off a sheet and stuffed it into his mouth. Seeing his body stiffen and twitch slightly, she suddenly couldn't bear it anymore and stomped out of the room.
It wasn't that I was sleepless at night, but I woke up from time to time, and the sound of the wind outside the window felt like whimpering.
On the second and third days, the cold poison had not faded away. Wan Mei suddenly remembered to visit Wan Xiang and stay there all day.
When I turned around in the evening, I was a little hungry. Wan Mei turned into the kitchen and saw the new cook holding the mistress in her arms, looking around not knowing what to do.
Seeing her come in, the cook quickly put her down: Master, look, I just came in to take a look at the supper, and saw him stuffing his hand into the stove. If he had been a step too late, his hand would have been burned.
Wan Mei lowered her waist and saw that half of Xiaosan's sleeves were indeed burned off, and her arms and palms were in terrible shape, the skin had been charred black and the flesh was torn apart.
She calmed down for a moment, watching Xiao San struggling and trying to get warm in the furnace. Suddenly she burst into tears and opened her arms to hug him.
This was the first time she cried since she came to the ghost gate. The tears were cold but hot. In her arms, the mistress gradually calmed down and stopped struggling.
It was finally over, three days and three nights of cold Gu attack, three days and three nights of two-phase torture.
After that, Xiao San rested for two days, and his wounds were hastily bandaged. According to his own words, if someone has a ghost, they can take good medicine, and these wounds are nothing at all.
Wan Mei felt a little regretful, but refused to say it. She just stared at Chun Mei outside the prison window.
Seeing the mistress standing behind her, she began to sigh: Today is my birthday, I am only seventeen years old, but why does it feel like I have lived several lifetimes?
She was a strong-willed person who rarely felt sad about spring or autumn. The mistress couldn't bear to hear this and turned around and went to the kitchen.
When I came back, I was holding a bowl of noodles in my hand, Yangchun noodles with a cool soup and finely chopped green onions floating on it.
Wan Mei picked one and tasted it was the work of the mistress and not the cook.
Seeing Xiaosan's gauze-wrapped hands, the soft part of her heart moved, and she said: Thank you for this bowl of longevity noodles. No matter whether you are sincere or fake to me, I thank you for this bowl of noodles.
The mistress still lowered her hand: "Then after the master finishes eating, let's plan this mission carefully."
Wan Mei's eyes suddenly dimmed: Yes, we need to plan. That person's name is Han Xiu, right? It is said that he is not only a first-class master, but also an orthodox man who is not a womanizer. He is a strict wife who loves his wife as much as she lives.
